nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Face Cleanser for Dry Skin

avis.texte: I love La Roche-Posay, but this is the first product from them that I really disliked. It honestly feels like I'm just rubbing water all over my face. I understand that it doesn't foam because it's a gentle cleanser, but after cleansing and then using toner on a cotton pad, it's obvious that it doesn't fully cleanse my skin. The cotton pad shouldn't still be dirty if I just washed my face. Unfortunately, this one just doesn't feel like it's doing enough.
This is such a reliable fash wash i will definitely be repurchasing over and over! Its the best.
Nice product, leaves skin clean and refreshed, not drying at all.

This cleanser burns my eyes and face. It dries my skin out badly. In my opinion, there's nothing gentle about it. I don't recommend this is you have sensitive skin. I have to use a different cleanser to remove my makeup because I can't get this anywhere near my eyes. I think I'll use it to wash my feet just to get rid of it.

I'm not sure the hype around this face wash, it doesn't lather at all I can barely tell if it's even on my hands. It doesn't get any excess makeup off so how can I be sure my face is actually clean afterwards? I feel like I paid for expensive water that was bottled up.

avis.titre: Niacinamide can burn if you use it in more than one product
avis.texte: It works amazingly well with my rosacea and sensitive skin. It's soft, not dry, honestly after using the products in the right order I don't need as much makeup. My skin looks great at 55. I've been told a lot that I look to be in early 40's.
This cleans nothing. It doesnt foam so it feels like just slapping a gel on tour face and wiping it off. Not going to buy again
I have been using this cleanser for over a year now. My skin changes with the seasons and when its dry this stuff is amazing. No tight dry skin after washing. This is now my go to almost year round.
I wouod not recommend this coranser for snyone with sensitive skin. This cleanser was not gentle. It burned around my nose and mouth. It was also drying in those areas and caused a rash.

avis.titre: After the first time using this my face felt soft & smooth!
avis.texte: I will buy this again & again & I will recommend it any one who has dry facial skin! It made a huge difference on my face which was severely dry NOT anymore!!
Love this i have super dry skin and doesnt make my face feel super dry or tight my only issue is sometimes it doesnt get my makeup all the way off but i just cleanse twice and it comes off
Chat GPT suggested this as a facial moisturizer for my 56 year old skin and I thought why not I take beauty advice from people on Tik Tok. This stuff is perfect for my skin. No more$$$$$ products
Not a bad cleanser. I always use an acne cleanser after this so that my face feels less oily!

avis.titre: this is the worst product ever

DO NOT BUY!!!
Great for sensitive skin with roscea. Recommend by dermatologist. Highly recommend.

Great for tweens and teens! Gentle and keeps skin clean. Have been looking for a cleanser that's gentle and effective, and this suits my sensitive skin. So even if you have sensitive skin, try this! (some people said that their skin burned, so be careful!)
I swear by this facial cleanser… this is my HOLY GRAIL 🫶🏼 cleanses my face without drying me out.

With such a glowing reputation, I was extremely disappointed. This is the first of their products I have tried, and supposed to be for sensitive skin which I have. This burned and stung my skin like strong acid. Horrible product. Lost faith in them.
Myself & husband both use this product. It does everything it should. Cleans & rinses well.

avis.titre: Perfect for POD and sensitive skin!
avis.texte: Buy this repeat need I say more? My skin has gotten more sensitive and more needy over the years that's to perimenopause… this helps a ton!
Excellent for those of us with dry skin. I use this as part of my double cleanse (part 2) and my skin barrier hasn't been compromised because this is such a gentle face wash.

Im over 40 & perimenopausal with dry skin lately. A friend suggested this product. I've been een using it for a 7 days but noticed a change already. it's very gentle and a little goes a long way. I noticed that my skin is very hydrated.

This is the only product i will use from this brand. It's actually for sensitive skin. Very lightweight and soothing. I put quiet a bit because its almost gel like and i clean my face and neck with it. Would recommend this product for very sensitive skin.

Wanted to like this but after 2-3 uses it REALLY burnt my skin :( I have sensitive dry skin and frankly I think this is better suited for those with oily skin. Also didnt do much to remove the very little makeup I had on

avis.titre: Love the packaging, reducing plastic waste
avis.texte: Lovethis facial wash, doesn't dry out my skin and my face feels clean
This product has helped my skin out tremendously i absolutely love it !
My face is very dry during the winter months. This face cleanser is so gentle. My face is calm and feels so smooth using this product.
Tried this new face cleanser and I'm not a fan left my skin feeling tight and irritated

I used to use a face cleanser that was supposed to be gentle, but I couldn't use it twice a day or even once daily because at some point, my skin would get irritated. I haven't had any issues with using this product daily. My face feels clean after I use it, but not stripped. I like that there's barely a scent, and the creamy/milky consistency is nice. It doesn't really lather which is fine. It took a little time to get used to that.

avis.titre: Don't buy if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: This facewash burned and irritated my skin. I used it 3 different times and all times it felt like my skin was burning. I have sensitive and acne prone skin. This does not help at all.

It's gentle, it's hydrating, it washes off easily, doesn't leave residue, doesn't cause acne, and feels soothing to irritated or sensitive skin. But, it's not the best for removing makeup, and especially not waterproof makeup. I still like it though, and it's a great second step in a double cleanse routine especially if the first wash is drying or stripping like salicylic acid washes. Also, I bought this to survive an exceedingly dry winter, with naturally combo to dry skin. It's been helpful.
Somehow I missed that this cleanser doesn't contain soap. I did use it and gave it several tries but felt it did nothing for my face. I prefer the La Roche wash over this.
I finished the whole face wash and will not be repurchasing. While it is hydrating it doesn't cleanse very well.

avis.titre: Drying and Irritating for Sensitives skin
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser since i started my dermatology ointments for my acne. It has been a over a year and a half that I have consistently used this product and have continued to have dry skin with no end in sight. It would leave my skin feeling tight and burn when i used it. I finally made the switch to the CeraVe Hydrating facial wash and will not be looking back. My skin no longer feels dry and doesnt burn when i wash it. Sometimes the higher price point doesnt indicate a better product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love this product. Cleanses without drying. Skin feels clean and soft. I plan to try other products in this same line.

I am making a serious effort this year for improving my skin. So I needed a cleanser that would clean but not be rough on my face or dry it out. So number 1, this doesn't really clean in my opinion. I wash my face with it but if I use a light colored towel, you can still see makeup etc coming off (I'm not a heavy makeup person so this isnt like 17 layers of whatever I'm asking this cleanser to remove). Second, and I saw a few reviews after I got it that said the same, its a slightly burning feeling on your face when you use it. I don't see any redness and it's not irritated after, it just feels odd/burning type thing.
this product does what it's supposed to. don't hate it but dont love it either. can't see myself repurchasing.

avis.titre: I absolutely love this product for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I suffer with rosacea and have had a super hard time finding something that doesn't irritate my skin and cause inflammation in my cheeks and one thing I love about this product is that it's really gentle and hydrating and really helps my skin out I 10 out of 10 would recommend this to anybody that struggles with like rosacea or dryness in their skin!

avis.titre: Super great cleanser for dry acne prone skin
avis.texte: Love this cleanser. I have repurchased for years. It is gentle and soft for dry skin and has never flared up my acne. Great price point for a great product.

avis.titre: I would recommend and buy this product again and again and
avis.texte: Love that is 73 or 70 something less percent micro plastics in it it does an amazing job I feel hydrated. I feel clean. It definitely has less chemicals and toxins and other brands so I definitely recommend this top notch.

This cleanser is effective. It cleans my skin thoroughly without irritation, tightness, or dryness, and my face feels clean and comfortable after every use. It's especially great for my sensitive, dry skin and helps maintain my skin barrier while still removing makeup and impurities. A dependable cleanser that truly works. I'll definitely continue using it.
I have sensitive skin and was scared to use this product, but I've been using it for a month and I love it. No breakout. Loving my skin now

I tried the cleanser fo a week and a half. My skin burned under my eyes and my cheek bone area. It also dried my skin on the forehead and chin to the point that my skin was flaking and my makeup was patchy. Within 3 days that I discontinued my skin improved and almost back to normal.

This is my favorite cleanser ever! I use this every night after I use a balm cleaner to get my sunscreen and makeup off. This cleanser leaves my face feeling clean but not drier out. I have very sensitive skin, but this cleanser has never once caused a breakout. I have bought the bottle and two of the refill sizes of this!

This product leaves my skin feeling clean and unstripped. It is good for my sensitive skin. Unfortunately, it leaves a residue on my skin that I notice as soon as I go and apply makeup. It causes a lot of my foundations and sunscreens to peel off like what happens to a rubber eraser when I take it to paper. Especially if I layer products. For example, if I add a color corrector below my foundation, the foundation will then peel off with the color corrector when I pat or rub it in. So, since I am a frequent makeup user, I will not be rebuying this.

I messed my skin barrier somehow. Everything that I put on my face burned. Did a bit of research and came across this cleanser and decided to try it out. It didn't irritate my skin and my face felt clean afterwords.

I have been using this cleanser now for 5 years. I have mature, sensitive, very OILY, skin that will react to almost anything. This milky hydrating cleanser leaves my face so clean and refreshed as it removes all my makeup. My face has had no reaction but soft supple hydrated skin and I hope La Rosche never changes the formulation. I absolutely live my Hyalu B5 that I apply after cleansing. My skin has never been better and after prolonged use of these two products I have had an excellent result. 🩵🩵🩵🩵🩵

I had heard great things about this product so i wanted to try it for myself. After finishing my bottle i wont be replacing, becuase i think there are gentler cleansers that do a better job for a better price.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it but couldn't
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser after I used my philosophy exfoliation cleanser. I placed some on my pmd, proceeded to cleanse my skin and experienced the worst burninng sensation on my face. It shocked me. I risned my face immediately. I tried it again the next morning and still felt a burning sensation on my face; fortunately not as bad. I rinsed my face again to use my peach and lily hydrating cleanser which helped calm my skin. Definitely returning this product. If i could give it zero stars i would.
use this after my oil cleanser. nice and gentle while still removing what it needs to. not drying on my combo skin. great price

This face wash is perfect for me because it's gentle but effective at cleansing my skin. My face truly feels cleansed after I use it. My last face wash was supposed to be gentle, but it still irritated my skin if I washed in the morning and evening with it. This one doesn't do that, so I'm a happy customer.
This is my first time trying the brand and absolutely love it and highly recommend it!
It's an okay cleanser, the cleansee did burn for a little but eventually it stopped. Will used until i find something better and definitely wont repurchase.

This cleanser is decent, good bang for your buck in terms of product. I have normal-dry skin and I saw so many recommendations for this being a wonderful cleanser. However, sometimes after using I would get a nose whitehead. Not sure if it's too stripping. I do get compliments on my skin glow, not sure if it is due to pregnancy though.
I broke out, clogged my pores and burned my face. I would not recommend this and i usually love la roche 😭

Idk how this has so many good reviews. It burned my skin, eyes and lips leaving me in red splotches. I will be returning. My usual cleanser has never done this, i was hoping this would work as im looking for cheaper options.

I was reslly excited to try this. I had been using Vanicream and ran out so I thought I would try this since so many people recommended it off tik tok. Sadly I'll have to return because this made my face really burn. It didnt really feel like it cleaned my face either but that could be because I was so focused on the burning. I dont have the most sensitive skin, but THIS irriates my skin like crazy. I was my face ans bu the end of my it, my lips/face feel like i put a lip plumper on Not sure whats in this but i don't recommend

avis.titre: Great cleanser for sensitive, dry skin

It's made a significant difference, still cleanses enough to keep pores free of black heads and other acne, yet gentle enough for the dry seasons of fall and winter. My skin is so sensitive and dry, it takes many trials to find the right product and this is perfect for me.

I was so excited to get thus cleanser after i tried a moisturizer from this brand. However, instead of soothing and hydrating my slim, it burned abd made it feel very uncomfortable. By the end if the day my skin started to peel. The foaming face wash in thr blue tube for ouky skin is much more gentle and does not make my skin feel that way.

avis.titre: It's a great daily wash for sensitive skin

It is very hydrating and is enjoyable to use. It is a creamy texture and does not foam so it may not seem like it's doing much when you apply but it always wonderful at cleansing my skin. Plus, the bottles huge
I've been using it for two years now no complaints from it. I don't even have to go in with a cleansing bomb to takeoff my makeup anymore.
Very light weight and non-residue. I have very sensitive skin so this product is now my go to.

At first I didn't like this cleanser because I felt like it didn't do anything, but then I used it in the shower to clear off a full face of makeup and it came completely off! I was fully expecting to have dark rings of mascara around my eyes but there was absolutely no residue, even after cleaning with micellar water. Very surprising!

Best cleaner and I've used quite a few, it's gentle while it cleanses and best of all it was on sale. Having gone through radiation has left my skin very dry and this product cleans my face and leaves it smooth even before I put on moisturizer! It's the best!
I love washing my face with this product because it cleans my sensitive/dry skin without issues.

avis.titre: Would purchase this again in later.

I love this brand yet first time purchase for this particular product. I have sensitive skin which made me think this would be good for me, but my face doesn't feel clean and feels like a light film left on my face.

avis.titre: This will be my go to from now on
avis.texte: I'm loving how my skin feels and looks since I started using this. It does a good job removing makeup too. I'm on a mission to decrease the amount of toxins I put on my body, and this product rated excellent. It's a keeper
I've tried countless cleansers, and this is the only one that I continue to re-purchase. It's so gentle on my skin, which can get really dry in the cold months and does not irritate my psoriasis.

I have combination skin and love this product, this is the only cleanser I have used for the past few years and have never had any issues. When I first started using this product I was having a few breakouts but when I used a their other product for acne prone skin it was too harsh for my sensitive skin in some areas. So I tried using both products at the same time. I would us the medicated cleanser on the areas needed and the gentle cleanser everywhere else and it worked like a charm! Now I just use the hydrating cleanser as my skin has cleared up. LOVE this product.
My family and friends notice the difference in my skincare routine with this product. I will definitely and recommend this to everyone. I like how it feels and much confidence in my skin now.
I have been using this for years. I feel like it cleans my skin without irritating it at all. I will continue to use as it is also extremely affordable.
It's so creamy, and feels so luxurious. It doesn't dry out my skin. My favorite cleanser by far.

I bought this product in hopes Of fixing some cystic acne I had been dealing with because of some hormonal changes. at first, when using this product my skin did feel softer. But with each use my skin texture went from being smooth with the occasional bump to having small bumps all over my face. i ended up developing acne in places I had never had it to begin with, like my chin And forehead, and it worsened the texture on my cheeks. i probably won't be using this line of product ever again as when i stopped using it my skin instantly became more clear.

I *don't* have sensitive skin and have never had a reaction to the many product I've tried. But this made my skin so hot, particularly the under eye/upper cheek area. I luckily haven't noticed any actual effect on my skin (aside from red for a bit following washing) and am discontinuing after about 3 washes.

avis.titre: Burning sensation - and I don't have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Tried it several times, but instantly gives burning sensation. Day after use, my skin is dry and peeling. Tried using it less often, but still the same issues. I don't have sensitive skin and never have had any issues with any skin care product.
I love this brand. It's gentle, so it's safe for sensitive skin. Cleans my face perfectly in the hot sweaty summer.

I have extremely sensitive, oily, mature skin and this cleanser is has been the best part of my skincare routine. I always follow-up with LP Hyaluronic B5 serum, along with my retinol and my face has never looked and felt better. 🩵
Started using this after struggling to find a good cleanser that wouldn't leave my skin dry. This is the second time I have purchased. Massive bonus points for having a refillable version of it.

I have acne prone skin with rosacea. I've been using this face wash for the past year & it has cleared up my skin. I don't break out in acne, and my roscea never flares up. I had issues with this brand's acne specific face wash causing acne & rosacea flare ups, but this one is gentle enough and cleans well.

This is my first time trying this brands cleanser and I love it. It is like a lotion type consistency a little bit goes a long way and it melts into your skin. I love how hydrated my skin looks and feels after using it.

avis.titre: I really wish more companies did this
avis.texte: In a day and time when everyone is concerned about waste I think this is amazing. Not only is it saving room in the land fill but it's also saving me a few dollars. Thank you so much for actually doing something other than taking about far off ideas. This applies to me on a daily basis as I hate to haul off a lot of trash from my country home. Also… great product!

I went to chat GPT in search of a new second cleanse because my old one was dangerously low, and not doing anything for me (i used the vanicream one), and based on my dry, reaction prone skin type, this was the one recommended. First of all, huge bottle!! Im sure that a bottle like this will last me over a year, since i only use one pump per use. Its also nice and hydrating as marketed, not leaving my skin feel tight and stripped, where i have to stretch my face to get rid of that feeling. Its very nice and gentle as well! Some things i didnt expect or really care for was the lack of foaming, which at first made me question if it worked or not, and the slight warmth it brought around my nose and upper lip. Though, no reaction happened, which works for me! Overall, its good! Trust me, even though it doesnt foam, it works, and it does the job.
This is my go-to cleanser for dry, sensitive skin. It's super gentle, doesn't strip, and leaves my skin feeling soft and calm. Love that there's a refill option too—eco-friendly and lasts forever!

So yo used this product for a week and it as help my skin repair damages from dryness! Having eczema is troublesome enough, so with this non harsh cleanser it does do its job. I wash my face with lukewarm water.

I had been wanting to try this for a while but it was so disappointing. It doesnt foam up at all so it doesnt feel like its even cleaning my face, and when i used it it burned my skin and made my face feel hot to the touch.

avis.titre: Perfect for sensitive, dry, eczema prone skin
avis.texte: This gentle cleanser is perfect for anyone with very sensitive skin that is flaky and dry. My boyfriend had visibly scaly patches from his eczema and this cleanser improved it greatly.

avis.titre: Very drying.  Enough with the niacinimide!
avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin and rosacea. This stuff remove makeup very well, and you have to use a sizable amount to get some makeup off. This also dried my skin out bad. I think it's the niacinmide in it. It seems niacinimide is still the rave, but it doesn't work for everyone and has been linked to dryness in other products. I guess LRP decided to get in on the niacinimide trend. Ugh. Won't buy again.

I have really dry skin, specially in my nose area. I feel like this cleanser does not really benefit or truly work for my skin. Just feels like im not really cleaning my skin or helping the dryness. I do love La Roche as i have their moisturizer.

avis.titre: Great for dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: My go to cleanser. I've tried many different cleansers that would remove my makeup without irritating my skin. This is the one! It's gentle on the skin and leaves it feeling clean. I also love that you can buy the refill pouches rather than purchasing the full bottle each time.

Y'all when I tell you my skin was as ANGRY, I'm not exaggerating. My skin was so dry and inflamed with severe breakouts after trying skin1004 centella ampoule foam and centella ampoule. I was seriously so disheartened. I bought this cleanser on recommendation from an Ulta employee and my skin was IMMEDIATELY relieved after just one wash. Immediately brought down the redness and inflammation and brought hydration back to my skin. Will keep you all updated as I continue to use it but 10/10 first impression!

I guess there's a first for everything but I wanted to try this brand as I heard it was affordable and worked great but this product did not in fact work great for me. I've never been one to react to any products really so I thought it was normal to feel this irritating, hot, burning feeling every single time after using this product until I realized how awful my skin started getting. Super red, itchy feeling and bumps everywhere on my face!

I have sensitive combination skin and it's okay with helping with breakouts. However, it really dries my skin out and makes my pores feel weird, as well as having a weird smell and not providing any moisture whatsoever.
My face was giving dull, so I decided to try. Honestly, in one week seems like I have a glow. I also have sensitive skin so anything that doesn't break me out I'm happy with.

I dont usually write reviews and i've been on a journey to find a new cleanser that clears my redness/acne, however this product made my skin worse. Almost feels like a burn as other reviews have mentioned. If you have acne prone & sensitive skin then proceed with caution….

avis.titre: Amazing Product! 10/10, very hydrating and softening.

I habe very oily skin and this cleans everything off wirhout being too drying. Ive tried lots of expensive cleansers and always come back to this.

Also, the soap for oily skin worked well for my skin type which is more dry.

This is my first time making a review, and I usually take them with a grain of salt. However like the past few conments have been saying, this burnt my skin as well. I had to use another face wash over it to get rid of the burning feeling and thats never happened to me before! Not good for sensitive skin & ive used this product in the past.

avis.titre: Saved my skin from drying out

I was skeptical about this cleanser, that it might be 'too gentle', however it cleanses my skin, removes makeup and it doesnt dry it out.

I wanted to give this brand a chance since it is a growing brand. This product unfortunately burned my skin more and more each time I used it, which is ironic bc its for sensitive skin... but the purifying wash by this brand seems to be working better for me.

I was so excited to try this , I have been comparing gentle cleansers and as a licensed esthetician this one seemed like the best option. worst thing ever I used damaged my skin and skin barrier made my skin so dry burning

I'm assuming this is the cause of my breakouts since I've had no routine changes
